transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've just been feeling incredibly down and sad for about five months now. It's gotten so heavy that I felt like I couldn't handle it on my own anymore, which is why I finally decided to seek help.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days where you felt the opposite of down—like you had unusually high energy, needed very little sleep, or felt extremely happy and active?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've mostly just felt completely exhausted and down. There haven't been any times where I felt happy or had high energy.
Did something specific happen in your life around five months ago, like a major change or stressful event, that seemed to trigger these feelings?

I can't think of any specific stressful event or major life change that happened five months ago. The heavy sadness just seemed to start out of nowhere around that time. But that is definitely when these feelings and everything else began.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you normally enjoy, like hobbies, spending time with friends, or work?

I'm not really sure about that, to be honest. I haven't really noticed whether I've lost interest in those things specifically, as everything just feels a bit foggy right now. I just haven't had the energy to think about much of anything lately.
Before these past five months, have you ever had a long period of two years or more where you felt consistently down, sad, or mildly depressed most of the time?
No, I've never had a long period like that before. Everything really just started for the first time five months ago, and before that, I felt okay.
How has your sleep been over these past five months? Have you had trouble falling or staying asleep, or have you been sleeping much more than usual?

My sleep has been absolutely terrible; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly, and often wake up way too early, though sometimes I end up sleeping for huge chunks of the day instead. I also keep having awful nightmares that disrupt my rest. No matter how much I sleep, I always wake up feeling completely exhausted and unrefreshed.
Have you ever experienced or witnessed an extremely traumatic, frightening, or life-threatening event in your life?
No, I've never experienced or witnessed anything traumatic or life-threatening like that. Nothing of that sort has ever happened to me.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over these past five months, like eating much less or much more than usual?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight over the past five months. My eating habits and weight have stayed pretty much the same as before.
Over these past five months, have you heard voices or seen things that others couldn't, or had strong beliefs that other people found unusual or hard to believe?

Yes, actually, and it's been really terrifying to deal with. I've been hearing quiet whispering voices when no one is around, and I constantly feel like people are watching or plotting against me. My family keeps telling me it's just in my head, but it feels so real.
Have you ever heard these whispering voices or felt like people were watching you during times when you were not feeling down or depressed?

No, I have only ever experienced those things when I am feeling deeply depressed. I've never heard the whispering or felt like I was being watched during times when my mood was normal. They only started happening after this heavy sadness began five months ago.
